draft.subject: Stamped — Japan rollout for post-purchase reviews
draft.body:
Hi Stamped team,

We’re A-one Road, a Yokohama company supporting commerce technology firms in Japan. We’re contacting Stamped about post-purchase review requests for Japanese DTC skincare retention teams managing replenishment journeys.

Japan’s May 2026 labour survey found regular-staff shortages at 34% of surveyed wholesale/retail establishments. For lean skincare teams, structured review requests can reduce manual follow-up while capturing product-use feedback at relevant points in the replenishment cycle.

We can lead one year of paid Japan market development: identify the entry application, evaluate Japanese buyer requirements, shape local introduction, and develop partner channels. Buyer evidence would guide request timing, response handling, and display governance. Can we help plan and execute Stamped’s Japan rollout around this workflow?

https://calendar.app.google/adKEhXC4UWhQXfJp6

Best regards,
Kazuma Tamura
Founder & CEO, A-one Road Co., Ltd. (Yokohama, Japan)
